label: SAFE
explanation: Khong tim thay vi pham trong 10 buoc unwind dau tien (SAFE-UP-TO-BOUND, khong phai chung minh an toan vo han).
description: Tong hop thu lao ca hoc ky: for (i = 0; i < MAX_LOP; i++) doc danhSachLop[i]. Vong lap dung chinh xac bang kich thuoc mang (safe_full_scan).

label: UNSAFE
explanation: Tai buoc unwind i=10, ton tai gia tri lam truy cap danhSachLop[index] voi index nam ngoai [0, 10).
description: Loi off-by-one kinh dien: for (i = 0; i <= MAX_LOP; i++) doc danhSachLop[i] - dieu kien dung '<=' thay vi '<', doc danhSachLop[10] la vuot bien (offbyone_scan).

label: UNSAFE
explanation: Tai buoc unwind i=1, ton tai gia tri lam truy cap danhSachLop[index] voi index nam ngoai [0, 10).
description: Xuat bang ke theo trang: doc danhSachLop[base_index + i], i = 0..4, voi base_index la offset trang nguoi dung nhap, KHONG duoc kiem tra truoc vong lap (symbolic_unsafe) - CWE-125 Out-of-bounds Read, soTiet rac di vao cong thuc tien day.

label: SAFE
explanation: Khong tim thay vi pham trong 5 buoc unwind dau tien (SAFE-UP-TO-BOUND, khong phai chung minh an toan vo han).
description: Giong BMC-03 nhung da them tien dieu kien base_index <= MAX_LOP - PAGE_SIZE (= 5) kiem tra truoc vong lap (symbolic_safe) -> an toan trong pham vi unwind da cho.

label: UNSAFE
explanation: Tai buoc unwind i=0, ton tai gia tri lam truy cap danhSachLop[index] voi index nam ngoai [0, 10).
description: Tu them (Buoc 5): in bang ke theo thu tu NGUOC (lop moi nhat truoc) doc danhSachLop[MAX_LOP - i], i = 0..4 (symbolic_reverse). Vi pham NGAY buoc i = 0 vi MAX_LOP - 0 = 10 = array_size nam ngoai bien.

label: SAFE
explanation: Khong tim thay vi pham trong 5 buoc unwind dau tien (SAFE-UP-TO-BOUND, khong phai chung minh an toan vo han).
description: Tu them: ban sua cua BMC-05 doc danhSachLop[MAX_LOP - 1 - i], i = 0..4 (symbolic_reverse_fixed) -> chi so chay 9,8,7,6,5 deu hop le.
